same_project_reason: The scientific question, frozen intervention, exact source binding, workload, comparator, and decision gate are unchanged. Mechanical evidence proves the candidate code was wholly absent from the candidate-labeled endpoint.

allowed: Make the retained predecessor installer idempotent under SGLang multiprocess startup.
Order the unchanged scheduler installer after the retained predecessor in every serving worker.
Add a worker-local installation-complete audit that does not change serving semantics.
Repair an ordinary pre-request injection failure in the same retained claim if mechanical proof still shows zero candidate execution.
forbidden: Changing the scientific intervention or its SHA256.
Changing checkpoint, runtime image, workload, concurrency, stacked predecessor, or decision gates.
Using the candidate-labeled no-op result as scheduler evidence.
A second scheduler candidate or flag sweep.
Repair after partial or ambiguous candidate execution.

measurement_contract.pre_request_gate: The actual serving worker must emit installation-complete proof for the unchanged scheduler implementation after the retained predecessor installer.
measurement_contract.endpoint: Rerun only the invalidated candidate endpoint once after the pre-request gate passes.
candidate_requirements: source, ordering-edge, and lifetime audit match the frozen intervention
measurement_contract.trace: Run one minimum candidate trace only after endpoint completion and runtime candidate-path proof.
measurement_contract.decision: Compare the repaired candidate with the retained valid control; retain a clean endpoint gain and close on semantic failure, non-positive result, or unchanged measured gap.
